residualGates.gate: Connected verification of current official Australian source URLs, publishers, licences, and permitted content modes
residualGates.reason: Requires current internet access and accountable source review.

residualGates.gate: Hosted Supabase project, RLS/grant, schema type, and migration acceptance
residualGates.reason: Offline source and schema evidence cannot prove hosted database state.
residualGates.requiredAuthority: Explicit hosted Supabase inspection and migration approval

residualGates.gate: Dry-run, targeted reindex, shadow retrieval, and paired evaluation waves
residualGates.reason: Mutates indexed corpus state and consumes hosted/provider capacity.
residualGates.requiredAuthority: Explicit per-wave reindex and evaluation approval

residualGates.gate: Live answer-provider canaries for quality, timeout, citation, abort, and fallback behaviour
residualGates.reason: Requires provider calls and may incur cost or expose approved test queries.

residualGates.gate: Controlled corpus activation with rollback proof and only then bounded cleanup
residualGates.reason: Changes live retrieval eligibility and may retire superseded indexed generations.
residualGates.requiredAuthority: Explicit activation, rollback, and cleanup approval

residualGates.gate: Deployment, production monitoring, anonymous/authenticated/admin parity canaries, and release acceptance
residualGates.reason: Changes production state and requires accountable operational observation.
residualGates.requiredAuthority: Explicit deployment and production acceptance approval
